title: Outcome sections for every pre-registered study that has run
description: Only three of the pre-registration documents under docs/ have an Outcome section, and several have no predictions table. For every study that has answers, append an Outcome section that scores each prediction against the result in the pre-registration's own words, with a Deviations block where the plan changed. For future studies, commit and tag the plan, and consider an external timestamp, before any answer is collected.
